description.en: Turns two characters to face each other for a dialogue exchange (the player and an NPC, typically), waiting for both turns to finish before restoring their idle/original motion.
Handle of the first character to turn.
Handle of the second character to turn.
Optional; whether to actually turn _main_hdl (defaults to true).
Optional; whether to actually turn _npc_hdl (defaults to true).
Optional; whether to call SYS_EVENT_STEP() while waiting (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Turn the player and an NPC to face each other before a conversation
QuickTurn(hTenmaL, hTsurugiL, true, true);
